sentences.en: each one of these new factors hits it harder and harder and makes it basically impossible to recover from.
sentences.zh: 每一个新的因素都会对其造成更沉重的打击，使其基本上无法恢复。

sentences.en: Yeah, when I first started covering this, it was most obvious in places that were already expensive.
sentences.zh: 是的，当我刚开始报道这个话题时，在那些本来就很昂贵的地方，这一点最为明显。

sentences.en: But then it just spreads year by year across the country.
sentences.zh: 但随后它年复一年地在全国蔓延开来。

sentences.en: It goes to smaller cities.
sentences.zh: 它蔓延到了较小的城市。

sentences.en: Even rural areas are starting to have a huge housing shortage.
sentences.zh: 甚至连农村地区也开始出现严重的住房短缺。

sentences.en: Each new place starts to contract the disease, to take our metaphor.
sentences.zh: 用我们的隐喻来说，每个新的地方都开始感染这种“疾病”。

sentences.en: And so there's this big game of musical chairs happening where people are moving all around the country in search of the next cheap housing market.
sentences.zh: 于是，这就上演了一场大型的大风吹游戏，全国各地的人们都在寻找下一个便宜的住房市场。

sentences.en: And eventually, it gets to the point where there's nowhere you can run anymore.
sentences.zh: 最终，情况发展到你再也无处可逃的地步。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温纳劳。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连连看》（Connections）这款游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作《拼字蜂》（Spelling Bee）和《连字网》（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚刚你听到声音的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: So, Connor, this crisis is spreading.
sentences.zh: 康纳，所以这场危机正在蔓延。

sentences.en: Affordable places are now becoming rare and attractive to those with money.
sentences.zh: 价格亲民的地方现在变得越来越稀少，并吸引了那些有钱人的目光。

sentences.en: And in turn, they're becoming endangered.
sentences.zh: 反过来，它们正面临着濒危的境地。

sentences.en: That's the state of play.
sentences.zh: 这就是目前的局势。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what we start seeing is cities in Middle America, smaller, regular cities, places that aren't finance hubs, places that aren't tech hubs,
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到的是美国腹地的城市，那些较小的、普通的城市，不是金融中心的地方，不是科技中心的地方，

sentences.en: places that have been trying to actually attract more residents and businesses for a long time.
sentences.zh: 那些长期以来一直试图吸引更多居民和企业的地方。

sentences.en: And suddenly, this precious resource they have, affordable housing, is exposed and vulnerable because everyone's discovered it.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，他们拥有的珍贵资源——经济适用房，由于被所有人发现而暴露在危险之中。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: This is Kalamazoo, Michigan, a diverse city of over 70,000 neighbors.
sentences.zh: 这里是密歇根州卡拉马祖，一个拥有超过7万居民的多元化城市。

sentences.en: And it even comes to cities like Kalamazoo, Michigan, which is a place no one expected the housing crisis to strike.
sentences.zh: 它甚至蔓延到了像密歇根州卡拉马祖这样的城市，这是一个没人预料到住房危机袭来的地方。

sentences.en: Kalamazoo has a lot of the amenities of a large town, but yet retains the small-town charm.
sentences.zh: 卡拉马祖拥有大城镇的许多便利设施，但同时又保留着小城镇的魅力。

sentences.en: We've got affordable housing, few traffic headaches, and very friendly people.
sentences.zh: 我们有经济适用的住房、极少的交通烦恼，还有非常友好的人们。

sentences.en: It's sort of between Detroit and Chicago, but it is absolutely not either of those places.
sentences.zh: 它位于底特律和芝加哥之间，但绝对不是这两个地方中的任何一个。

sentences.en: You know, it's urban, but then it's natural.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它既有都市感，又贴近自然。

sentences.en: It's a small town with really big-town attractions.
sentences.zh: 这是一个拥有大都市景致的小镇。

sentences.en: It's got so much to offer for a town its size.
sentences.zh: 以它这个体量的城镇来说，这里能提供的实在太多了。

sentences.en: It's a pretty blue-collar town.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当典型的蓝领小镇。

sentences.en: You know, if you make $100,000 or even less, you can have a very comfortable life there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你年收入达到10万美元甚至更少，你就能在那里过上非常舒适的生活。

sentences.en: And Kalamazoo is getting some great attention.
sentences.zh: 卡拉马祖正受到极大的关注。

sentences.en: It was ranked the coolest place to live with the lowest cost of living in the entire country.
sentences.zh: 它被评为全美生活成本最低、最酷的居住地。

sentences.en: How about that?
sentences.zh: 觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: Go Kalamazoo!
sentences.zh: 卡拉马祖加油！

sentences.en: Yeah, quite the honor.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真是个莫大的荣誉。

sentences.en: It's a place where money goes a lot further, and so it's much more comfortable to be a middle-income family there.
sentences.zh: 在这里，钱能经花得多，因此中等收入家庭生活起来要舒适得多。

sentences.en: You can have a bigger house.
sentences.zh: 你可以住更大的房子。

sentences.en: You can do more things.
sentences.zh: 你可以做更多的事情。

sentences.en: People discover our community, and they might think, hey, this would be a great place to live.
sentences.zh: 人们发现了我们的社区，他们可能会想，嘿，这会是个居住的好地方。

sentences.en: This would be a great place to work.
sentences.zh: 这会是个工作的好地方。

sentences.en: This would be a great place to raise a family.
sentences.zh: 这会是个抚养家庭的好地方。

sentences.en: A lot of the people there think of that affordability as almost like a condition of the place.
sentences.zh: 那里的很多人认为这种负担能力几乎就像是这个地方的一种天然属性。

sentences.en: It's like winter.
sentences.zh: 就像冬天一样。

sentences.en: It's something that Kalamazoo has.
sentences.zh: 这是卡拉马祖本来就有的东西。

sentences.en: Right, fact of life.
sentences.zh: 对，这是生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a fact of life.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Until everything we're talking about comes to Kalamazoo.
sentences.zh: 直到我们刚才谈论的一切降临到卡拉马祖。

sentences.en: And Connor, I'm familiar with what the housing shortage and its impact look like in coastal cities, because I live in one of them.
sentences.zh: 康纳，我很清楚住房短缺及其影响在沿海城市是什么样的，因为我就住在其中一个城市里。

sentences.en: But what does it look like when all of this arrives at the doorstep of a place like Kalamazoo?
sentences.zh: 但是，当这一切降临到像卡拉马祖这样地方的门口时，会是什么样子呢？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, the most obvious first thing you see is prices exploding.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，你首先看到最明显的事情就是价格暴涨。

sentences.en: Home prices go up about 40% since the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 自大流行以来，房价上涨了约40%。

sentences.en: Rents go up about 50%.
sentences.zh: 租金上涨了约50%。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, all of a sudden, anybody looking for housing finds that it's way more expensive.
sentences.zh: 所以，突然之间，任何寻找住房的人都会发现它要昂贵得多。

sentences.en: And, of course, at first, that affects people with the least money.
sentences.zh: 当然，起初这会影响那些钱最少的人。

sentences.en: They've got the least room in their budget.
sentences.zh: 他们的预算空间最小。

sentences.en: So, you start to see homelessness or people living out of hotels, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，你开始看到无家可归的现象，或者人们住在酒店里，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But it moves up the income ladder because the shortage gets worse and worse and worse and worse and the competition gets more and more fierce.
sentences.zh: 但随着短缺情况愈演愈烈、竞争日趋白热化，这种情况会向上蔓延到更高的收入阶层。

sentences.en: And people who were having no problem affording housing are all of a sudden getting overwhelmed by this problem.
sentences.zh: 那些原本买得起房的人突然也被这个问题压得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: Let's record her on, if that's okay.
sentences.zh: 如果我们录音没问题的话，我们就把她录下来。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I'm Connor.
sentences.zh: 我是康纳。

sentences.en: What was her name?
sentences.zh: 她叫什么名字？

sentences.en: I'm Barb Tackett Denny.
sentences.zh: 我是芭芭拉·塔基特·丹尼。

sentences.en: And I met a woman going through exactly this.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一位正经历这一切的女性。

sentences.en: Her name's Barbara Tackett Denny.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫芭芭拉·塔基特·丹尼。

sentences.en: She goes by Barb.
sentences.zh: 大家都叫她芭芭拉（Barb）。

sentences.en: And Barb, how old are you?
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉，你多大了？
我67岁。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And are you retired or what do you do?
sentences.zh: 你是退休了还是做什么工作？

sentences.en: I do home health.
sentences.zh: 我做家庭护理。

sentences.en: So, I take care of somebody older than me.
sentences.zh: 所以，我在照顾一个比我年长的人。

sentences.en: She works as a home health aide and her husband works in a factory.
sentences.zh: 她是一名家庭护理助理，她的丈夫在工厂工作。

sentences.en: Together, they make about $65,000 a year, which in Kalamazoo is solidly middle class.
sentences.zh: 他们俩加起来年收入约6.5万美元，在卡拉马祖这绝对算得上是坚实的中产阶级。

sentences.en: And the reason it's solidly middle class is that they can find an affordable place.
sentences.zh: 它之所以算得上是坚实的中产阶级，是因为他们能找到一个负担得起的住处。

sentences.en: So, for 10 years, they lived in a duplex.
sentences.zh: 因此，十年来他们一直住在一栋复式公寓里。

sentences.en: It was two bedrooms, one bathroom, living room, dining room.
sentences.zh: 那是两室一厅一卫，带客厅和餐厅。

sentences.en: The house is about 100 years old.
sentences.zh: 房子大约有100年历史了。

sentences.en: And their rent was only $630 a month.
sentences.zh: 他们的房租每月仅需630美元。

sentences.en: We used to go out to eat.
sentences.zh: 我们过去常常出去吃饭。

sentences.en: Barb told me that, you know, she felt generally fine.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉告诉我，你知道，她感觉总体上还不错。

sentences.en: They even saved a little bit.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至还存了一点钱。

sentences.en: Now, this was not a fancy place.
sentences.zh: 当然，这不是什么高档地方。

sentences.en: In the 10 years that we've been there, he's done no major overhauls, nothing.
sentences.zh: 在我们住在那里的十年里，房东没有做过任何重大的翻修，什么都没有。

sentences.en: I asked him for carpet every year.
sentences.zh: 我每年都向他要求换地毯。

sentences.en: The carpet was sort of ratty and not very nice.
sentences.zh: 地毯有点破烂，不是很好。

sentences.en: It had knob and tube electrical.
sentences.zh: 屋里用的是老式的旋柄瓷管绝缘电线。

sentences.en: If I run my microwave and he happens to plug in something upstairs, it'll blow the fuse.
sentences.zh: 如果我开微波炉，而他在楼上顺便插上什么东西，就会烧断保险丝。

sentences.en: She had to sort of coordinate with the neighbor over who was going to use the microwave or other appliances when, because the fuses would blow if they both used them.
sentences.zh: 她不得不和邻居协调谁在什么时候使用微波炉或其他电器，因为如果他们同时使用，保险丝就会烧断。

sentences.en: But it was affordable for them.
sentences.zh: 但对他们来说是负担得起的。

sentences.en: And it made it so that their income went a long way.
sentences.zh: 这使得他们的收入很经花。

sentences.en: So, economists and housing wonks refer to this as naturally occurring affordable housing, which is the euphemism for kind of a crappy place.
sentences.zh: 因此，经济学家和住房专家将此称为“自发产生的经济适用房”，这是一个用来形容有点破烂的住处的委婉说法。

sentences.en: Down on its heels, old.
sentences.zh: 破旧不堪，年久失修。

sentences.en: It's a place that's affordable for an obvious reason.
sentences.zh: 这是一个因为显而易见的原因而买得起的地方。

sentences.en: That is a huge piece of our affordable housing puzzle in America.
sentences.zh: 这是我们美国经济适用房拼图中的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Sort of older housing that gives people a way to make their money go a little bit further, right?
sentences.zh: 某种程度上比较旧的住房，能让人们的钱稍微经花一点，对吧？

sentences.en: So, they're living there and everything's pretty good.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们住在那里，一切都还挺好的。

sentences.en: That's their situation.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的现状。

sentences.en: Until their landlord decides to sell.
sentences.zh: 直到他们的房东决定出售房屋。

sentences.en: And that's something that happens in a hot market.
sentences.zh: 这就是在火热的市场中会发生的事情。

sentences.en: The landlord has had this place where the price of it hasn't changed much in a long time.
sentences.zh: 房东一直拥有这个地方，其价格很长一段时间都没有什么变化。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, he can get all this money for this kind of ratty duplex, right?
sentences.zh: 突然之间，他可以为这种破旧的复式公寓卖到一大笔钱，对吧？

sentences.en: Much more than he ever thought.
sentences.zh: 比他想象的要多得多。

sentences.en: So, they all of a sudden have to go looking for a new place.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们突然不得不去找一个新的住处。

sentences.en: And they are just now in this market that they almost didn't know existed.
sentences.zh: 而他们现在刚一进入这个市场，才发现它几乎是他们闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: And lots of other landlords have sold their ratty duplexes.
sentences.zh: 许多其他的房东也卖掉了他们破旧的复式公寓。

sentences.en: And investors have moved in and families have moved in.
sentences.zh: 投资者进驻了，家庭也搬进来了。

sentences.en: And they're fixing them up.
sentences.zh: 他们正在整修这些房子。

sentences.en: And the home prices are going up.
sentences.zh: 房价正在上涨。

sentences.en: The rents are going up.
sentences.zh: 租金正在上涨。

sentences.en: And just everything is becoming more expensive.
sentences.zh: 简直是万物涨价。

sentences.en: They eventually land in a manufactured home.
sentences.zh: 他们最终落脚在一处组合屋里。

sentences.en: But it costs about $1,600 a month.
sentences.zh: 但每个月的费用大约是1600美元。

sentences.en: And their whole entire budget has just been nuked.
sentences.zh: 他们的整个预算刚刚被彻底摧毁了。

sentences.en: What has been your lifestyle adjustment?
sentences.zh: 你们的生活方式做了什么调整？

sentences.en: I mean, that's $1,000 more dollars a month.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是一个月多花1000美元。

sentences.en: Well, we've had to cut back on everything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们不得不削减一切开支。

sentences.en: They were never wealthy, right?
sentences.zh: 他们以前也谈不上富有，对吧？

sentences.en: But money has gone from something they didn't stress out about over every single bill to all we think about is every penny.
sentences.zh: 但金钱的意义已经从“不会为每一笔账单感到压力”变成了“我们脑子里想的全是每一分钱”。

sentences.en: It just kind of sucks.
sentences.zh: 这感觉真够糟糕的。

sentences.en: You know, as much money as what he makes and as hard as what we both work
sentences.zh: 你知道，凭他挣的那些钱，加上我们俩工作这么辛苦，

sentences.en: and to think, can we really afford this?
sentences.zh: 再想想，我们真的负担得起吗？

sentences.en: You know, it's like, why am I working so hard?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就像是在想，我为什么还要这么拼命工作？

sentences.en: And if you just zoom out, you can find someone like Barb basically anywhere in America right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你退一步来看，你现在在美国几乎任何地方都能找到像芭芭拉这样的人。

sentences.en: You know, the census just put out a report that said about half of all renters are cost burdened right now, which means they spend more than a third of their income on rent.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人口普查局刚刚发布了一份报告，称目前大约有一半的租房者背负着沉重的住房成本负担，这意味着他们将三分之一以上的收入花在租金上。

sentences.en: And a good amount of that group spends more than half.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分人甚至将超过一半的收入花在上面。

sentences.en: So there are people all over this country now who they basically work to survive.
sentences.zh: 所以现在全国各地都有这样的人，他们基本上是为了生存而工作。

sentences.en: They work to pay for rent.
sentences.zh: 他们工作是为了付房租。

sentences.en: They work to pay for housing.
sentences.zh: 他们工作是为了支付住房费用。

sentences.en: And I think what people need to realize is that at a moment when people are really mad about inflation,
sentences.zh: 我认为人们需要意识到的是，在人们对通货膨胀感到非常愤怒的时刻，

sentences.en: when the presidential campaign is all about how can we reduce prices on middle class Americans,
sentences.zh: 在总统竞选完全围绕着如何减轻中产阶级美国人的物价压力展开时，

sentences.en: yeah, grocery bills are up and the cost of milk and cheese and bacon and all these things are up.
sentences.zh: 是的，杂货账单上涨了，牛奶、奶酪、培根以及所有这些东西的成本都上涨了。

sentences.en: But really at the heart of that inflation pain is the cost of housing.
sentences.zh: 但这种通货膨胀痛苦的核心其实是住房成本。

sentences.en: So given just how widespread this problem has become, how much financial pain it's causing to people like Barb, just the sweep of it, you know, from San Francisco to Kalamazoo,
sentences.zh: 鉴于这个问题已经变得如此普遍，给像芭芭拉这样的人带来了多少经济痛苦，从旧金山到卡拉马祖，它的波及范围如此之广，

sentences.en: how does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国到底该

sentences.en: really start to pull itself out of a situation?
sentences.zh: 如何真正开始摆脱这种困境？

sentences.en: How does it treat this sick patient?
sentences.zh: 它该如何治疗这个重病患者？

sentences.en: What feels very clear to me here is that any kind of a half measure isn't going to cut it.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这里非常清楚的一点是，任何半心半意的措施都是无济于事的。

sentences.en: For example, lowering the interest rate, as the Federal Reserve did a few days ago, something anxiously awaited by anyone trying to buy a house.
sentences.zh: 例如，正如美联储几天前所做的那样降低利率，这是任何想买房的人都急切期盼的事情。

sentences.en: That seems like a nice thing to do, but it's not going to solve our housing shortage.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是一件好事，但这并不能解决我们的住房短缺问题。

sentences.en: No, absolutely it will not.
sentences.zh: 不，绝对不会。

sentences.en: And it could even make things worse because things like lowering the interest rates might increase the demand, but they don't really increase the supply.
sentences.zh: 它甚至可能会让情况变得更糟，因为诸如降息之类的举措可能会增加需求，但它们并不能真正增加供应。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it would seem like the answer has to require us to go back to that original problem and basically just go on a massive building spree.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来答案不得不要求我们回到那个最初的问题，基本上就是开启一轮大规模的建设热潮。

sentences.en: And how do you even start to undertake that?
sentences.zh: 你甚至该如何着手去做这件事呢？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So you hit the nail on the head, which is, I guess, a good building metaphor, right?
sentences.zh: 所以你一针见血地指出来了，这大概是个不错的建筑比喻，对吧？

sentences.en: So we need a building boom and some outside force is going to have to push the industry to build way more housing than it is currently capable of or even wants to, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要一波建设热潮，某种外部力量将不得不推动房地产行业建造远超其目前能力、甚至远超其意愿的住房，对吧？

sentences.en: And that outside force is almost certainly going to be the public sector, state, local, and ultimately the federal governments.
sentences.zh: 而这种外部力量几乎肯定会是公共部门，包括州政府、地方政府，以及最终的联邦政府。

sentences.en: And the reason is, is that the entire model is now so upside down that it's often more expensive to build a house.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，整个模式现在已经彻底颠倒了，以至于建造一栋房子的成本往往变得极高。

sentences.en: It costs too much in land, too much in two by fours, too much in labor, that a builder can't even make money for a price that a middle class person could afford to buy it for.
sentences.zh: 土地成本太高，木材成本太高，劳动力成本太高，以至于开发商甚至无法以中产阶级买得起的价格建房来赚钱。

sentences.en: So what do they do?
sentences.zh: 那他们会怎么做呢？

sentences.en: They build much higher end homes.
sentences.zh: 他们会建造更高档的住宅。

sentences.en: And what happens is this kind of idea of the middle class starter home essentially starts to go extinct.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，中产阶级入门级住宅这种概念基本上开始走向消亡。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Builders can more easily make a profit catering to the rich, and that's what a lot of them do.
sentences.zh: 开发商更容易通过迎合富人来获取利润，这也是他们许多人正在做的事。

sentences.en: You just said that it's going to take the government to push builders to build what we actually need them to build, which is a whole lot of affordable and middle income housing.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说，需要政府来推动开发商建造我们真正需要他们建造的东西，也就是大量经济适用房和中等收入住房。

sentences.en: So what kind of tools does the government have at its disposal to accomplish that?
sentences.zh: 那么政府手里有什么样的工具来实现这一点呢？

sentences.en: Everywhere you go in America, you're going to hear a lot of different programs, but they're really going to only do one of two things.
sentences.zh: 无论你在美国的什么地方，你都会听到很多不同的项目，但它们实际上只做两件事中的一件。

sentences.en: You're either going to make it way easier to build or you're going to spend money doing it.
sentences.zh: 要么是让建造变得容易得多，要么就是花钱来推动。

sentences.en: So the first one is reducing regulatory barriers like zoning restrictions to see how many units can be on an acre or environmental rules that kind of
sentences.zh: 所以第一种是减少监管壁垒，比如分区限制——看看一英亩土地上可以建多少个单位，或者诸如此类的环保规则，

sentences.en: stretch out the timeline for how long it takes to get building.
sentences.zh: 这些规则拉长了开工建设所需的时间线。

sentences.en: There are design rules.
sentences.zh: 还有设计规则。

sentences.en: There's a million little rules for how you build and you can either get rid of them or reduce them.
sentences.zh: 关于如何建造有成千上万条细小的规则，你要么取消它们，要么减少它们。

sentences.en: And that makes building easier, faster, and less expensive.
sentences.zh: 这会让建设变得更轻松、更快、成本更低。

sentences.en: The second thing you could do is put money into it.
sentences.zh: 你能做的第二件事就是往里面投钱。

sentences.en: The government could build the housing on its own in some cases, or it can just give subsidies in the
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，政府可以自己建造住房，或者它也可以发放补贴，

sentences.en: form of tax breaks or even direct subsidies to developers who typically then are asked to make the housing more affordable in some way.
sentences.zh: 形式可以是税收减免，甚至是直接补贴给开发商，而开发商通常会被要求以某种方式让这些住房更具可负担性。

sentences.en: And I actually saw a really interesting version of that in Kalamazoo.
sentences.zh: 我实际上在卡拉马祖见到了一个非常有趣的例子。

sentences.en: So one thing the state of Michigan is doing is trying to incentivize builders to just do more.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州正在做的一件事，就是试图激励开发商做得更多。

sentences.en: And they've done this by expanding subsidies to developers for pretty much any housing that's built.
sentences.zh: 他们通过向开发商扩大补贴来实现这一点，补贴几乎涵盖任何建造的住房。

sentences.en: And they've added additional subsidies for housing that's really targeted at the middle class.
sentences.zh: 他们还为真正针对中产阶级的住房增加了额外的补贴。

sentences.en: Kalamazoo, though, went even further.
sentences.zh: 不过，卡拉马祖走得更远。

sentences.en: People in the county recently voted to create a housing fund that allows them to subsidize all kinds of different housing projects, everything from
sentences.zh: 该县的居民最近投票设立了一个住房基金，这让他们能够补贴各种不同类型的住房项目，从

sentences.en: basically homeless shelters to middle-class housing.
sentences.zh: 基本上是无家可归者收容所，到中产阶级住房应有尽有。

sentences.en: They even raised the level of what income is eligible now for subsidized housing.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至提高了现在有资格获得住房补贴的收入标准。

sentences.en: In Kalamazoo, it used to be that you had to have a household income of under $80,000.
sentences.zh: 在卡拉马祖，过去你必须家庭年收入在8万美元以下才行。

sentences.en: Now you can make all the way up to about $120,000 a year to qualify for housing aid or subsidized housing.
sentences.zh: 现在你每年赚到大约12万美元左右，也有资格获得住房援助或保障性住房。

sentences.en: And so what's happening is they're really changing how they think about housing aid.
sentences.zh: 所以正在发生的情况是，他们真的在改变对住房援助的看法。

sentences.en: It's gone from something we think of as traditionally being aimed at lower income families and households to basically most people can qualify for housing subsidies now.
sentences.zh: 它已经从我们传统上认为旨在帮助低收入家庭和住户的东西，变成了现在基本上大多数人都能获得住房补贴。

sentences.en: But what you're describing so far feels mostly like useful, but ultimately local and scattershot efforts here.
sentences.zh: 但你到目前为止所描述的，感觉大多是有用的，但终究是局部的、零星的努力。

sentences.en: And so some communities are going to get their act together, come up with these subsidies, others perhaps are not.
sentences.zh: 所以一些社区会振作起来，拿出这些补贴，而另一些社区可能不会。

sentences.en: Is there any compelling national program underway to address this housing shortage?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么令人瞩目的国家级项目正在推进以解决这场住房短缺？

sentences.en: I know that both Kamala Harris and Donald Trump do make housing a pretty big focus of their policy proposals.
sentences.zh: 我知道卡玛拉·哈里斯和唐纳德·特朗普确实都把住房作为他们政策提案的一个相当大的重点。

sentences.en: So there's no plan I have heard that sounds like it's really compelling or some panacea, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我听说过的没有任何一个计划听起来真正引人注目或是什么灵丹妙药，对吧？

sentences.en: But what I have heard is what you just said, presidential candidates repeatedly talking about this.
sentences.zh: 但我听到的正如你刚才所说，总统候选人反复在谈论这个。

sentences.en: Kamala Harris, for instance, has a plan that aims to subsidize builders who build entry-level
sentences.zh: 比如，卡玛拉·哈里斯有一个计划，旨在补贴建造入门级

sentences.en: homes, starter homes as they're called, and also to subsidize the buyers who would buy homes like that.
sentences.zh: 住宅的开发商，也就是所谓的起步房，同时也补贴会购买这类房屋的购房者。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has talked about reducing regulations on housing.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普则谈到了放宽对住房的监管。

sentences.en: But really, if you cut through it, they both sort of describe this as a crisis of too little.
sentences.zh: 但说实话，如果你透过现象看本质，他们俩其实都把这描述为一场供给过少的危机。

sentences.en: And I think that is a sign of progress.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个进步的迹象。

sentences.en: I know that their solutions, such as they are, are radically different, but they recognize that there is some problem of not enough housing.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们的解决方案大相径庭，但他们认识到了住房不足的问题所在。

sentences.en: And I think that in a polarized society, anytime you see an area of agreement, even if all the agreement is is what the problem is, that is, I would say, a positive sign.
sentences.zh: 我认为在一个极化的社会里，任何时候只要你看到达成一致的领域，哪怕这种一致仅仅在于问题是什么，我想这也是一个积极的信号。

sentences.en: But a positive sign is not a bricks and mortar plan to build millions of new housing units.
sentences.zh: 但积极的信号并不是建造数百万套新住房的砖瓦计划。

sentences.en: So in your mind, how long is it going to take for the United
sentences.zh: 所以在你看来，美国需要

sentences.en: States to solve this problem?
sentences.zh: 花多长时间才能解决这个问题？

sentences.en: And how optimistic are you that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你对美国

sentences.en: is going to get its act together and actually figure this out?
sentences.zh: 能够振作起来并真正搞定这件事有多大乐观态度？

sentences.en: Tough question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个棘手的问题。

sentences.en: You know, we began this conversation by saying it took us almost 20 years to get here, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在对话开始时说过，我们花了差不多20年才走到这一步，对吧？

sentences.en: So it's kind of foolhardy to think you're going to get out of it right away.
sentences.zh: 所以认为你能马上摆脱困境未免有点太天真了。

sentences.en: I don't know that it'll take us another 20 to get out of it, but you need to have many years, probably 10 years of sustained focused effort.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们是否还需要另外20年才能摆脱困境，但你需要多年的时间，可能需要10年持续且专注的努力。

sentences.en: But look, we've done this before.
sentences.zh: 但是听着，我们以前也这么做过。

sentences.en: After the Great Depression, there was a huge housing crunch.
sentences.zh: 在大萧条之后，曾出现过严重的住房危机。

sentences.en: There were ads for people to live in chicken coops.
sentences.zh: 当时甚至有广告让人住在鸡舍里。

sentences.en: There was even famously an ad for someone selling an icebox as a sort of studio apartment.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有个著名的广告，有人把一个冰柜当成某种单身公寓来卖。

sentences.en: But after World War II ended, there was a massive building boom.
sentences.zh: 但在第二次世界大战结束后，出现了一波大规模的建设热潮。

sentences.en: Single family housing starts in this country went from about 100,000 in 1944 to about 1.7 million just six years later.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的单户住宅开工量从1944年的大约10万套飙升到短短六年后的约170万套。

sentences.en: So this can be done.
sentences.zh: 所以这是可以做到的。

sentences.en: What's happening in the middle there is this massive increase in investment from the government, things like the GI Bill, things like lending prograMs. There is a full-on national
sentences.zh: 在这中间发生的是政府投资的大幅增加，比如《退伍军人权利法案》，比如贷款项目。当时开展了一场全方位的国家级

sentences.en: effort to build housing to create really the modern middle class in the modern suburbs.
sentences.zh: 努力来建造住房，从而在现代郊区真正缔造了现代中产阶级。

sentences.en: I'm not saying it's going to happen exactly like that this time.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说这次会完全以那种方式发生。

sentences.en: It's just worth noting that when you put your focus on an issue, really, really, really big things can happen.
sentences.zh: 这只是值得指出的是，当你把注意力集中在一个问题上时，真正、真正、非常巨大的事情就会发生。

sentences.en: But then again, we are not the United States of 1950 anymore.
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，我们已经不再是1950年的那个美国了。

sentences.en: There is no political consensus on almost anything.
sentences.zh: 几乎在任何事情上都不存在政治共识。

sentences.en: And there's always, when it comes to the government intervening and spending money,
sentences.zh: 而且每当涉及政府干预和花钱时，

sentences.en: suspicion and sometimes anger over why is somebody else getting something, a handout that I'm not getting.
sentences.zh: 总是伴随着怀疑，有时甚至是对“为什么别人能得到我得不到的施舍”的愤怒。

sentences.en: And so how do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 那么你是怎么看待这一点的呢？

sentences.en: So I think that the weakest argument against the government doing this is that it's pushing us
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，反对政府这样做的最站不住脚的论点是，它在把我们推向

sentences.en: in a new direction, a newly subsidized housing market, because this has always been how it has been.
sentences.zh: 一个新方向——一个全新补贴的住房市场，因为情况一直以来都是这样的。

sentences.en: Pretty much the entire housing market is subsidized in some way.
sentences.zh: 几乎整个住房市场都以某种方式受到补贴。

sentences.en: From the 30-year fixed mortgage that you think banks give you out of the goodness of their heart to huge tax breaks that
sentences.zh: 从你以为银行出于好心才给你的30年期固定利率抵押贷款，到人们

sentences.en: people get for their mortgage interest, et cetera, the federal government has its financial heft and power into pretty much the entire housing market.
sentences.zh: 因抵押贷款利息等获得的巨额税收减免，联邦政府将其财政影响力和权力渗透到了几乎整个住房市场。

sentences.en: And really on a more abstract level, you could argue that pretty much all of land is to some extent subsidized.
sentences.zh: 而且从更抽象的层面来说，你可以认为几乎所有的土地在某种程度上都得到了补贴。

sentences.en: I mean, think about homes that are near public transit, homes that are near- Or schools.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，想想那些靠近公共交通的住宅，靠近——或是学校的住宅。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Homes that are near a really great public school system, some of the most expensive homes in
sentences.zh: 那些靠近真正优秀的公立学校系统的住宅，是美国最贵的

sentences.en: America.
sentences.zh: 一些房子。

sentences.en: So the idea that people work really hard and acquire homes through their own grid.
sentences.zh: 所以那种认为人们通过自身的不懈努力工作来获得房屋的观点……

sentences.en: I mean, yes, people do work hard.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是的，人们确实在努力工作。

sentences.en: And yes, you do have to save up for a down payment.
sentences.zh: 是的，你也确实必须为首付存钱。

sentences.en: But the entire real estate market is subsidized to some degree.
sentences.zh: 但整个房地产市场在某种程度上都是受到补贴的。

sentences.en: And really the question is, who do we subsidize and to what extent?
sentences.zh: 真正的问题其实是，我们到底在补贴谁？补贴到什么程度？

sentences.en: Fair question.
sentences.zh: 问得好。

sentences.en: And to bring us back to where we started this conversation, from what you're saying, this sick patient of a U.S.
sentences.zh: 为了把我们带回对话开始的地方，根据你的说法，美国这个病入膏肓的

sentences.en: housing market now needs the government's help.
sentences.zh: 住房市场现在需要政府的帮助。

sentences.en: And the government has been subsidizing the housing market when it wasn't sick in all kinds of ways for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 而且在它没有生病的时候，政府也长期以各种方式一直在补贴住房市场。

sentences.en: And so there's a reasonably compelling case for the government to intervene now, meaningfully and broadly, when the crisis, the patient, is in a very acute situation.
sentences.zh: 因此，当危机和这个“病人”处于非常严峻的境地时，政府现在进行有意义、大范围的干预，有着相当充分且令人信服的理由。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But it's going to require the kind of concentration and focus that governments, frankly, aren't that used to putting in.
sentences.zh: 但这将需要那种坦白说政府并不太习惯投入的专注力和集中的精力。

sentences.en: But the reason I think that they can and ultimately will solve this is that it's not going away.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们能够并且最终将解决这个问题的原因在于，它不会消失。

sentences.en: There are certain problems like, say, the federal deficit or a natural disaster that rear their head and seem really acute, but then they kind of fade away from memory.
sentences.zh: 有些问题，比如联邦赤字或自然灾害，它们抬头时显得非常严峻，但随后就会渐渐淡出人们的记忆。

sentences.en: This is not going to fade away.
sentences.zh: 这个问题不会淡出。

sentences.en: The housing crisis we have right now is going to be worse next year.
sentences.zh: 我们现在面临的住房危机在明年会更糟。

sentences.en: I don't care what happens with interest rates.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎利率会发生什么变化。

sentences.en: It's going to probably be worse the year after that.
sentences.zh: 再过一年，情况可能还会更糟。

sentences.en: And so at some point, the size of the problem and the fact that it is not going away is going to create the conditions for that focused effort.
sentences.zh: 所以在某个时刻，问题的规模以及它不会消失的事实，将为那种专注的努力创造条件。

sentences.en: Well, Connor, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，康纳，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, Israel inched toward all-out war with Hezbollah, launching airstrikes on more than 1,300 targets inside Lebanon that killed nearly 500 people,
sentences.zh: 周一，以色列向黎巴嫩境内的1300多个目标发动了空袭，造成近500人死亡，向着与真主党全面战争的方向步步逼近，

sentences.en: according to Lebanese health officials.
sentences.zh: 根据黎巴嫩卫生官员的数据。

sentences.en: It was the deadliest day in Lebanon since 2006 when Israel last fought a war with Hezbollah,
sentences.zh: 这是自2006年以色列与真主党上一次交战以来，黎巴嫩死伤最惨重的一天，

sentences.en: the Iranian-backed group that the United States has classified as a terrorist organization.
sentences.zh: 真主党是一个受到伊朗支持、被美国列为恐怖组织的团体。

sentences.en: In response, Hezbollah launched its own barrage of about 165 rockets into Israeli territory, according to Israel.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，据以色列称，真主党向以色列领土发射了约165枚火箭弹进行密集轰炸。

sentences.en: Hezbollah has been firing rockets and drones from Lebanon into Israel since last October in support of Hamas, prompting Israeli counterattacks.
sentences.zh: 自去年10月以来，真主党为了支持哈马斯，一直在从黎巴嫩向以色列发射火箭弹和无人机，这引发了以色列的反击。

sentences.en: I have a message for the people of Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 我有一条信息要带给黎巴嫩人民。

sentences.en: Israel's war is not with you.
sentences.zh: 以色列的战争不是针对你们的。

sentences.en: It's with Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 而是针对真主党的。

sentences.en: For too long, Hezbollah has been using you as human shields.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，真主党一直将你们当作人肉盾牌。
